why.redacted: The provider sent this reasoning only encrypted or left it out, so there is no text to show.
why.thinkingDisplay: The agent's thinking display leaves the text out. Choose “Show summarized” in the agent's thinking options to receive it.
why.notRequested: The provider sends reasoning summaries only on request. An administrator can turn on “Request reasoning summaries” in the settings.
why.notExposed: This model does not reason, or its provider never sends its reasoning. Nodestro never makes up reasoning text.
why.noText: The provider marked a reasoning phase but sent no text.

source.text: Sent by the model while it reasoned. Not part of the answer.
source.summary: A summary the provider writes of reasoning it does not expose. Not part of the answer.

settings.title: Reasoning display
settings.intro: How the reasoning of models is shown while they work. Only what the provider sends is shown; Nodestro never writes reasoning text itself.
settings.displayHint: Applies to the assistant, the run chat, workflow runs, the Workflow Architect and the agent test. A conversation can choose its own display.
settings.summariesHint: Asks OpenAI and Gemini for summaries of the reasoning of models that reason. Changes no answer and no cost; OpenAI may require a verified organization. Anthropic models follow the agent's thinking display.
settings.adminOnly: Only administrators can change this setting.

model.summary: Live reasoning: this model's provider sends reasoning summaries.
model.summaryNotRequested: Live reasoning: this model's provider sends reasoning summaries only when the workspace asks for them (settings).
model.thinking: Live reasoning: this model sends its thinking text.
model.none: Live reasoning: this model does not send any reasoning.
model.unknown: Live reasoning: whether the server sends reasoning depends on its configuration.
